title: dispatch-worktrees — the dispatcher's worktree disposition playbook
description: Use this at run start, at every worktree creation, and at Step 7 teardown, or when asked what to do with leftover worktrees. The dispatcher's playbook for worktrees: stamp an owner at creation, classify every worktree read-only, give each exactly one disposition, and retain so nothing accumulates and nothing valuable is discarded. Load when creating a worktree (stamp), sweeping at run start, tearing down at close, or when a worktree holds unmerged or dirty work.
author: sox
